macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-toned, depigmented muzzle and the dark-pigmented cheek and periocular regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Low 2D vertical thickness with a slight structural droop and protrusion of the lower lip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular pinkish/reddish area on the lower neck/throat region; small dark circular mark on the right cheek.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense pattern of dark pigmentation spots (freckling) distributed across the light-skinned muzzle.
